subject: Allocating compliance add-on costs for multi-region deployment
messages:
From: Jane Liu <jane.liu@medstream.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medstream.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-on costs for multi-region deployment

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency profile and the routing options. As we scope a pilot across US and EU regions, procurement is asking for a clear breakdown of where compliance-related costs sit and how we should expect those to scale. Specifically: KMS/HSM seats, audit log retention/egress, and per-region data residency fees (if any).

Can you share a proposal that shows (a) unit pricing for each add-on, (b) recommended allocation model for a 2-region deployment, and (c) options that would qualify for a single consolidated discount? We are targeting a committed pilot (6–12 months) that could convert to an annual contract.

Appreciate a short, line-item view to bring to procurement.

—Jane
Jane Liu
Head of Cloud Ops, MedStream Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jane Liu <jane.liu@medstream.com>
Cc: procurement@medstream.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on costs for multi-region deployment

Jane — thanks, really helpful context. I attached a concise line-item proposal (redwood-compliance-cost-split-proposal-v1.pdf) and the raw pricing model (pricing-model-breakdown.xlsx). High level notes up front: 

- KMS/HSM: we price HSM seats per-region when customers require dedicated FIPS/HSM tenancy. If you prefer a pooled HSM approach across regions, we can offer a pass-through + 20% ops surcharge.
- Audit logs: retention tiers (30/90/365 days) priced per GB/day; EU region egress is billed at the EU rate.
- Residency: there is a one-time region onboarding fee for EU production (data transfer/configuration), but no ongoing per-request penalty — cost is mostly the storage & egress differential.

Proposed allocation for a two-region pilot (US + EU): 
- KMS/HSM: 60% allocated to region that requires HSM tenancy (you noted EU clinical workloads may require it). Suggest we bill the EU HSM seat to MedStream and include a 50% credit for the US region for the pilot.
- Audit logs: split 50/50 by ingestion volume; we can offer a 10% consolidated discount if logs and residency are contracted together.

For a 12-month commit we can put together a 12% bundled discount across compliance add-ons and waive the EU onboarding fee. If you only do 6 months, discount drops to 6% and onboarding fee remains.

I do need internal approval for the 12% — looping in Laura and Priyom on that ask.

Next steps: confirm target commit length and whether you want HSM pooled or per-region seats. I can convert the attached into a formal SOW once we agree.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Compliance add-on costs for multi-region deployment — approval request

Team — forwarding the ask from MedStream. Key points: they want line-item pricing and a bundled discount for a pilot that may convert to an annual deal (deal id MS-2027-0891). My proposed levers: 12% bundled discount on 12-month commit, waive EU onboarding fee, and give a 50% pilot credit on the US HSM seat if they buy an EU HSM seat full price. They'll likely push for credits instead of seats. Attachments included above.

Questions for approval: 
1) Approve 12% bundled discount if they sign 12 months?
2) Approve EU onboarding fee waiver only if they commit to prod parity (SLA + annual)?
3) Approve the 50% pilot credit (US) as a one-time credit on their first invoice?

Laura — last time we agreed on a 10% max for mid-market. Priyom — any objections on HSM pass-through logic?

Laura Bennett: "Ben — ok for 12% if they commit to 12 months and sign the standard SLA. Waive the EU onboarding fee for that term. Do not give HSM credit without explicit HSM seat purchase in contract."

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jane Liu <jane.liu@medstream.com>
Cc: procurement@medstream.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on costs for multi-region deployment — proposal attached

Jane — thanks for the patience. Based on internal approvals below, here is the formal proposal we discussed (attached): redwood-compliance-cost-split-proposal-v1.pdf. Summary of the agreed commercial terms for a 12-month pilot that converts to annual on renewal: 

- Bundled discount: 12% off listed compliance add-on line items (KMS/HSM seats, audit log retention, residency onboarding).
- EU onboarding fee: waived for 12-month commit when SLA and enterprise support are included.
- HSM seats: EU HSM seat billed at list price; we will apply a one-time 50% credit to the US HSM seat for the pilot period only. If you later move to pooled HSM, a 20% ops surcharge applies.
- Audit logs: charged per GB/day with 365-day tier included in the bundle at the discounted rate. Split billed by ingestion region.

Attachments: pricing-model-breakdown.xlsx (detailed calculator), SOC2-evidence-stub.txt (sample artifacts). I can convert this into an SOW and route a DocuSign once you confirm the following: 
1) Confirm 12-month pilot -> annual renewal path? (yes/no)
2) Confirm you accept the one-time US HSM credit (yes/no)
3) Confirm enterprise support + SLA inclusion to unlock the onboarding waiver (yes/no)

If that looks good I’ll prepare the SOW and send a DocuSign link. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement through line-items.

Best,
